title: Owned Chromium inherited-pipe transport

claims.text: _decode_frame rejects duplicate keys, non-finite numbers and unpaired surrogates, while PipeClient refuses argv with a remote-debugging-port, appends --remote-debugging-pipe, and launches Chromium with inherited pipe descriptors 3 and 4.

_frame reads NUL-delimited frames bounded at 1048576 bytes, and call routes events without an id to the capped events log while matching responses by pending request id and session, raising wrong_target on mismatch.
close requests Browser.close, then terminates and finally kills a still-running process, raising cleanup_incomplete when cleanup fails.

triggers: response id does not match pending

decision.rule: Change here when the pipe startup, frame bounds, request routing, or browser teardown needs to change.
decision.failure: Requests hang past their deadline, a mismatched response is accepted, or close leaves the browser process running.

questions.q: Where does PipeClient start Chromium with inherited pipe descriptors?
Where should I change the frame size bound or event log cap?
Where can I debug why call raises wrong_target for a response?
